def utc_now() -> str:
    return (
        datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        .replace(microsecond=0)
        .isoformat()
        .replace("+00:00", "Z")
    )


def normalize_term(value: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(
        str(value).strip().casefold().split()
    )


def slugify(value: str) -> str:
    value = normalize_term(value)

    value = re.sub(
        r"[^a-z0-9_-]+",
        "-",
        value,
    )

    value = re.sub(
        r"-+",
        "-",
        value,
    ).strip("-")

    if not value:
        value = "historical"

    if not value[0].isalpha():
        value = f"h-{value}"

    return value


def load_registry() -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = yaml.safe_load(
        REGISTRY_PATH.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )

    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise TypeError(
            "registry must be a YAML object"
        )

    lexemes = payload.get("lexemes")

    if not isinstance(lexemes, list):
        raise TypeError(
            "registry.lexemes must be a list"
        )

    return payload


def provenance_object(
    value: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        result = dict(value)

        confidence = result.get(
            "confidence"
        )

        if (
            confidence is not None
            and confidence
            not in VALID_CONFIDENCE
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "invalid existing provenance "
                f"confidence: {confidence!r}"
            )

        return result

    if isinstance(value, list):
        sources = [
            str(item).strip()
            for item in value
            if str(item).strip()
        ]

        return {
            "sources": sources,
            "confidence": "confirmed",
        }

    if isinstance(value, str):
        source = value.strip()

        return {
            "sources": (
                [source]
                if source
                else []
            ),
            "confidence": "confirmed",
        }

    if value is None:
        return {
            "sources": [],
            "confidence": "confirmed",
        }

    raise TypeError(
        "unsupported provenance shape: "
        f"{type(value).__name__}"
    )


def ensure_lineage(
    lexeme: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    lineage = lexeme.get("lineage")

    if lineage is None:
        lineage = {}

    if not isinstance(lineage, dict):
        raise TypeError(
            f"{lexeme.get('id')}: lineage "
            "must be an object"
        )

    supersedes = lineage.get(
        "supersedes"
    )

    if supersedes is None:
        supersedes = []

    if not isinstance(supersedes, list):
        raise TypeError(
            f"{lexeme.get('id')}: "
            "lineage.supersedes must be a list"
        )

    history = lineage.get("history")

    if history is None:
        history = []

    if not isinstance(history, list):
        raise TypeError(
            f"{lexeme.get('id')}: "
            "lineage.history must be a list"
        )

    lineage["supersedes"] = list(
        supersedes
    )

    lineage.setdefault(
        "superseded_by",
        None,
    )

    lineage["history"] = list(history)

    lexeme["lineage"] = lineage

    return lineage


def build_indexes(
    lexemes: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> tuple[
    dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
]:
    by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    by_canonical: dict[
        str,
        list[dict[str, Any]],
    ] = {}

    for lexeme in lexemes:
        lexeme_id = str(
            lexeme.get("id", "")
        ).strip()

        canonical = str(
            lexeme.get("canonical", "")
        ).strip()

        if not lexeme_id:
            raise ValueError(
                "lexeme missing id"
            )

        if lexeme_id in by_id:
            raise ValueError(
                f"duplicate lexeme id: "
                f"{lexeme_id}"
            )

        by_id[lexeme_id] = lexeme

        if canonical:
            by_canonical.setdefault(
                normalize_term(canonical),
                [],
            ).append(lexeme)

    return by_id, by_canonical


def unique_history_id(
    predecessor: str,
    successor_id: str,
    by_id: Mapping[
        str,
        dict[str, Any],
    ],
) -> str:
    base = (
        "lex:history:"
        f"{slugify(predecessor)}"
    )

    if base not in by_id:
        return base

    existing = by_id[base]

    if (
        normalize_term(
            existing.get(
                "canonical",
                "",
            )
        )
        == normalize_term(predecessor)
        and ensure_lineage(
            existing
        ).get(
            "superseded_by"
        )
        == successor_id
    ):
        return base

    digest = hashlib.sha256(
        (
            predecessor
            + "\0"
            + successor_id
        ).encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()[:10]

    candidate = (
        f"{base}-{digest}"
    )

    if candidate in by_id:
        existing = by_id[candidate]

        if (
            normalize_term(
                existing.get(
                    "canonical",
                    "",
                )
            )
            != normalize_term(
                predecessor
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "historical lexeme id "
                f"collision: {candidate}"
            )

    return candidate


def add_history_event(
    lineage: dict[str, Any],
    event: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    history = lineage.setdefault(
        "history",
        [],
    )

    if event not in history:
        history.append(event)


def materialize_predecessor(
    *,
    predecessor_name: str,
    successor: dict[str, Any],
    lexemes: list[dict[str, Any]],
    by_id: dict[
        str,
        dict[str, Any],
    ],
    by_canonical: dict[
        str,
        list[dict[str, Any]],
    ],
) -> str | None:
    successor_id = str(
        successor["id"]
    )

    normalized = normalize_term(
        predecessor_name
    )

    if (
        successor_id,
        normalized,
    ) in SPECIAL_NON_SUPERSESSION:
        successor_lineage = (
            ensure_lineage(successor)
        )

        add_history_event(
            successor_lineage,
            {
                "event": (
                    "historical-label-replaced"
                ),
                "historical_term": (
                    predecessor_name
                ),
                "current_term": successor.get(
                    "canonical"
                ),
                "scope": (
                    "identity-tier-2-only"
                ),
                "global_supersession": False,
            },
        )

        return None

    if predecessor_name in by_id:
        predecessor = by_id[
            predecessor_name
        ]

        predecessor_id = (
            predecessor_name
        )

    else:
        matches = by_canonical.get(
            normalized,
            [],
        )

        if len(matches) > 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "ambiguous predecessor "
                f"canonical term: "
                f"{predecessor_name!r}"
            )

        if matches:
            predecessor = matches[0]
            predecessor_id = str(
                predecessor["id"]
            )

        else:
            predecessor_id = (
                unique_history_id(
                    predecessor_name,
                    successor_id,
                    by_id,
                )
            )

            predecessor = {
                "id": predecessor_id,
                "canonical": (
                    predecessor_name
                ),
                "concept": (
                    "Historical predecessor of "
                    f"{successor.get('canonical')}"
                ),
                "layer": successor.get(
                    "layer",
                    "shard00",
                ),
                "status": "superseded",
                "lineage": {
                    "supersedes": [],
                    "superseded_by": (
                        successor_id
                    ),
                    "history": [
                        {
                            "event": (
                                "superseded"
                            ),
                            "successor": (
                                successor_id
                            ),
                        }
                    ],
                },
                "provenance": {
                    "sources": [
                        (
                            "lexical-migration-"
                            "20260809"
                        )
                    ],
                    "confidence": (
                        "confirmed"
                    ),
                },
            }

            lexemes.append(
                predecessor
            )

            by_id[
                predecessor_id
            ] = predecessor

            by_canonical.setdefault(
                normalized,
                [],
            ).append(
                predecessor
            )

            return predecessor_id

    if predecessor is successor:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{successor_id} cannot "
            "supersede itself"
        )

    predecessor_status = str(
        predecessor.get(
            "status",
            "",
        )
    ).strip()

    if predecessor_status == "active":
        predecessor["status"] = (
            "superseded"
        )

    elif predecessor_status not in {
        "superseded",
        "deprecated",
        "reserved",
    }:
        predecessor["status"] = (
            "superseded"
        )

    if (
        predecessor.get("status")
        != "superseded"
    ):
        predecessor["status"] = (
            "superseded"
        )

    predecessor_lineage = (
        ensure_lineage(
            predecessor
        )
    )

    current_successor = (
        predecessor_lineage.get(
            "superseded_by"
        )
    )

    if (
        current_successor
        not in (
            None,
            "",
            successor_id,
        )
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{predecessor_id} already "
            "superseded by "
            f"{current_successor}, cannot "
            f"also supersede to "
            f"{successor_id}"
        )

    predecessor_lineage[
        "superseded_by"
    ] = successor_id

    add_history_event(
        predecessor_lineage,
        {
            "event": "superseded",
            "successor": successor_id,
        },
    )

    predecessor["provenance"] = (
        provenance_object(
            predecessor.get(
                "provenance"
            )
        )
    )

    return predecessor_id


def normalize_registry(
    registry: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    raw_lexemes = registry[
        "lexemes"
    ]

    lexemes: list[
        dict[str, Any]
    ] = []

    for raw in raw_lexemes:
        if not isinstance(raw, Mapping):
            raise TypeError(
                "every lexeme must be an object"
            )

        lexeme = dict(raw)

        lexeme["provenance"] = (
            provenance_object(
                lexeme.get(
                    "provenance"
                )
            )
        )

        ensure_lineage(lexeme)

        lexemes.append(lexeme)

    registry["lexemes"] = lexemes

    by_id, by_canonical = (
        build_indexes(lexemes)
    )

    original_lexemes = list(
        lexemes
    )

    for successor in original_lexemes:
        successor_id = str(
            successor["id"]
        )

        lineage = ensure_lineage(
            successor
        )

        original_predecessors = list(
            lineage.get(
                "supersedes",
                [],
            )
        )

        resolved_ids: list[str] = []

        for predecessor_value in (
            original_predecessors
        ):
            predecessor_name = str(
                predecessor_value
            ).strip()

            if not predecessor_name:
                continue

            resolved = (
                materialize_predecessor(
                    predecessor_name=(
                        predecessor_name
                    ),
                    successor=successor,
                    lexemes=lexemes,
                    by_id=by_id,
                    by_canonical=(
                        by_canonical
                    ),
                )
            )

            if (
                resolved
                and resolved
                not in resolved_ids
            ):
                resolved_ids.append(
                    resolved
                )

                add_history_event(
                    lineage,
                    {
                        "event": (
                            "supersedes"
                        ),
                        "predecessor": (
                            resolved
                        ),
                        "successor": (
                            successor_id
                        ),
                    },
                )

        lineage["supersedes"] = (
            resolved_ids
        )

    by_id, by_canonical = (
        build_indexes(lexemes)
    )

    for lexeme in lexemes:
        lexeme_id = str(
            lexeme["id"]
        )

        lineage = ensure_lineage(
            lexeme
        )

        superseded_by = (
            lineage.get(
                "superseded_by"
            )
        )

        if superseded_by:
            successor = by_id.get(
                str(superseded_by)
            )

            if successor is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{lexeme_id}: unresolved "
                    "superseded_by "
                    f"{superseded_by}"
                )

            successor_lineage = (
                ensure_lineage(
                    successor
                )
            )

            if (
                lexeme_id
                not in successor_lineage[
                    "supersedes"
                ]
            ):
                successor_lineage[
                    "supersedes"
                ].append(
                    lexeme_id
                )

                add_history_event(
                    successor_lineage,
                    {
                        "event": (
                            "supersedes"
                        ),
                        "predecessor": (
                            lexeme_id
                        ),
                        "successor": str(
                            successor["id"]
                        ),
                    },
                )

    registry["lexemes"] = sorted(
        lexemes,
        key=lambda item: (
            0
            if item.get("status")
            == "active"
            else 1,
            str(
                item.get(
                    "id",
                    "",
                )
            ),
        ),
    )

    return registry


def validate_normalized(
    registry: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> None:
    lexemes = registry.get(
        "lexemes"
    )

    if not isinstance(lexemes, list):
        raise TypeError(
            "normalized lexemes missing"
        )

    by_id = {
        str(item["id"]): item
        for item in lexemes
    }

    if len(by_id) != len(lexemes):
        raise ValueError(
            "duplicate lexeme ids after "
            "normalization"
        )

    canonical_owners: dict[
        str,
        list[str],
    ] = {}

    for lexeme in lexemes:
        lexeme_id = str(
            lexeme["id"]
        )

        provenance = lexeme.get(
            "provenance"
        )

        if not isinstance(
            provenance,
            Mapping,
        ):
            raise TypeError(
                f"{lexeme_id}: provenance "
                "is not an object"
            )

        lineage = lexeme.get(
            "lineage"
        )

        if not isinstance(
            lineage,
            Mapping,
        ):
            raise TypeError(
                f"{lexeme_id}: lineage "
                "is not an object"
            )

        supersedes = lineage.get(
            "supersedes"
        )

        if not isinstance(
            supersedes,
            list,
        ):
            raise TypeError(
                f"{lexeme_id}: supersedes "
                "is not a list"
            )

        if supersedes and not isinstance(
            lineage.get("history"),
            list,
        ):
            raise TypeError(
                f"{lexeme_id}: "
                "supersession lacks history"
            )

        for predecessor_id in supersedes:
            predecessor = by_id.get(
                str(predecessor_id)
            )

            if predecessor is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{lexeme_id}: unresolved "
                    "predecessor "
                    f"{predecessor_id}"
                )

            if (
                predecessor.get("status")
                != "superseded"
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{predecessor_id}: "
                    "predecessor not superseded"
                )

            predecessor_lineage = (
                predecessor.get(
                    "lineage"
                )
            )

            if (
                not isinstance(
                    predecessor_lineage,
                    Mapping,
                )
                or predecessor_lineage.get(
                    "superseded_by"
                )
                != lexeme_id
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{predecessor_id}: "
                    "bidirectional "
                    "supersession mismatch"
                )

        canonical = str(
            lexeme.get(
                "canonical",
                "",
            )
        ).strip()

        if canonical:
            canonical_owners.setdefault(
                normalize_term(canonical),
                [],
            ).append(
                lexeme_id
            )

    duplicates = {
        canonical: owners
        for canonical, owners
        in canonical_owners.items()
        if len(owners) > 1
    }

    if duplicates:
        raise ValueError(
            "duplicate canonical spellings "
            f"after normalization: "
            f"{duplicates}"
        )

    shard = [
        item
        for item in lexemes
        if normalize_term(
            item.get(
                "canonical",
                "",
            )
        )
        == "shard"
        and item.get("status")
        == "active"
    ]

    mote = [
        item
        for item in lexemes
        if normalize_term(
            item.get(
                "canonical",
                "",
            )
        )
        == "mote"
        and item.get("status")
        == "active"
    ]

    if len(shard) != 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "global Shard must remain "
            "exactly one active lexeme"
        )

    if len(mote) != 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "Mote must remain exactly one "
            "active lexeme"
        )

    mote_supersedes = set(
        ensure_lineage(
            mote[0]
        ).get(
            "supersedes",
            [],
        )
    )

    if str(shard[0]["id"]) in (
        mote_supersedes
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Mote must not supersede "
            "global Shard"
        )


def main() -> int:
    registry = load_registry()

    timestamp = (
        datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        .strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    )

    backup = (
        REGISTRY_PATH.parent
        / "backups"
        / "lexical-migration-20260809"
        / timestamp
        / "registry.yaml"
    )

    backup.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    shutil.copy2(
        REGISTRY_PATH,
        backup,
    )

    normalized = normalize_registry(
        registry
    )

    validate_normalized(
        normalized
    )

    output = yaml.safe_dump(
        normalized,
        sort_keys=False,
        allow_unicode=True,
        width=100,
    )

    REGISTRY_PATH.write_text(
        output,
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    print(
        "LEXICON REGISTRY NORMALIZATION: "
        "complete"
    )

    print(
        f"REGISTRY: {REGISTRY_PATH}"
    )

    print(
        f"BACKUP: {backup}"
    )

    print(
        "LEXEMES: "
        f"{len(normalized['lexemes'])}"
    )

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# carbon avatar forge api

## owner

carbon

## status

active

## purpose

avatar forge is carbon's embodied-simulation ingress and substrate-projection application.

it receives explicitly consented source material and projects normalized, stable, inspectable, reusable embodiment manifests.

## canonical runtime

`apps/avatar_forge/run.sh`

## application

`avatar_forge.api.main:app`

## network defaults

host: `127.0.0.1`

port: `8787`

runtime overrides:

- `CARBON_AVATAR_FORGE_HOST`
- `CARBON_AVATAR_FORGE_PORT`

## projection surfaces

avatar forge may expose:

- source intake
- consent state
- normalized embodiment packets
- identity manifests
- texture projection manifests
- voice profile manifests
- rig export manifests
- packet audits
- lineage
- provenance
- compatibility metadata

## invariants

- explicit consent is required for represented-person reconstruction.
- source possession does not establish consent.
- generated structures are projections, not new identity authority.
- source lineage must remain recoverable.
- provenance must remain attached where available.
- downstream composition does not transfer carbon authority.
- external reconstruction backends may extend avatar forge without replacing its canonical ownership.
- external provider execution remains owned by the appropriate provider-orchestration element.

from runtime.constitution import ConstitutionalRegistry
from runtime.pryme import (
    Pryme,
    PrymeAuthorityBinding,
    bind,
)

assert binding_status["valid"] is True

#!/usr/bin/env python3

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Mapping


runtime_root = Path(
    "/root/savant-runtime/"
    "ontology/obelisks/_template/"
    "segue/gates/_template/segue/"
    "innates/_template/segue/"
    "exiles/carbon/runtime"
)

if str(
    runtime_root
) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(
        0,
        str(
            runtime_root
        ),
    )


from oriel import (  # noqa: E402
    oriel_error,
)

from oriel_inverse import (  # noqa: E402
    capability_manifest,
    engine,
    oriel_inverse_error,
    status,
)


def read_json(
    path: str,
) -> Any:
    if path == "-":
        return json.load(
            sys.stdin
        )

    return json.loads(
        Path(
            path
        ).read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def read_object(
    path: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = read_json(
        path
    )

    if not isinstance(
        value,
        dict,
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "input must be a JSON object"
        )

    return value


def csv_values(
    value: str | None,
) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []

    return [
        item.strip()
        for item
        in value.split(
            ","
        )
        if item.strip()
    ]


def focused_selftest() -> dict[str, Any]:
    document = {
        "locations": [
            {
                "id":
                    "alpha",

                "name":
                    "alpha",

                "latitude":
                    40.0,

                "longitude":
                    -75.0,

                "source_class":
                    "verified_external",
            },
            {
                "id":
                    "beta",

                "name":
                    "beta",

                "latitude":
                    41.0,

                "longitude":
                    -74.0,

                "timezone":
                    "America/New_York",

                "source_class":
                    "verified_external",
            },
        ],

        "routes": [
            {
                "source":
                    "alpha",

                "target":
                    "beta",

                "mode":
                    "tour_bus",

                "distance_km":
                    180,

                "minimum_minutes":
                    150,

                "maximum_minutes":
                    210,

                "source_class":
                    "verified_external",
            },
        ],

        "events": [
            {
                "id":
                    "earlier-scene",

                "kind":
                    "scene",

                "entities": [
                    "band"
                ],

                "location_id":
                    "alpha",

                "start":
                    (
                        "2026-01-01"
                        "T15:00:00-05:00"
                    ),

                "duration_minutes":
                    120,

                "teardown_minutes":
                    30,

                "source_class":
                    "simulation",
            },
        ],
    }

    desired = {
        "id":
            "desired-scene",

        "kind":
            "scene",

        "entities": [
            "band"
        ],

        "location_id":
            "beta",

        "start":
            (
                "2026-01-01"
                "T18:00:00-05:00"
            ),

        "duration_minutes":
            60,

        "source_class":
            "simulation",
    }

    result = engine.search(
        document,
        desired,
        mode="tour_bus",
        policy={
            "resolution_minutes":
                30,

            "maximum_candidate_shift_minutes":
                240,

            "maximum_existing_shift_minutes":
                240,

            "maximum_depth":
                4,

            "maximum_states":
                200,

            "solution_limit":
                4,
        },
    )

    nearest = result.get(
        "nearest_solution"
    )

    if not isinstance(
        nearest,
        Mapping,
    ):
        raise oriel_inverse_error(
            (
                "focused inverse test "
                "produced no solution"
            )
        )

    nearest_classification = str(
        nearest.get(
            "classification",
            "",
        )
    )

    if (
        nearest_classification
        not in {
            "viable",
            "conditional",
        }
    ):
        raise oriel_inverse_error(
            (
                "focused inverse test "
                "did not find a feasible repair"
            )
        )

    if result.get(
        "historical_anchors_moved"
    ):
        raise oriel_inverse_error(
            (
                "focused inverse test "
                "moved historical anchors"
            )
        )

    if result.get(
        "source_state_mutated"
    ):
        raise oriel_inverse_error(
            (
                "focused inverse test "
                "mutated source state"
            )
        )

    if result.get(
        "canon_effect"
    ) != "none":
        raise oriel_inverse_error(
            (
                "focused inverse test "
                "created canon effect"
            )
        )

    return {
        "schema":

                "savant.carbon.oriel-inverse."
                "focused-selftest.v1"
            ),

        "owner":
            "carbon",

        "component":
            "oriel-inverse",

        "authority_effect":
            "none",

        "ok":
            True,

        "evaluated_state_count":
            result.get(
                "evaluated_state_count"
            ),

        "visited_state_count":
            result.get(
                "visited_state_count"
            ),

        "viable_count":
            result.get(
                "viable_count"
            ),

        "conditional_count":
            result.get(
                "conditional_count"
            ),

        "unresolved_count":
            result.get(
                "unresolved_count"
            ),

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="carbon-oriel-inverse",
        description=(
            "Carbon-owned inverse chronology "
            "and logistics search"
        ),
    )

    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(
        dest="command",
        required=True,
    )

    subparsers.add_parser(
        "status"
    )

    subparsers.add_parser(
        "capabilities"
    )

    subparsers.add_parser(
        "selftest"
    )

    search_parser = (
        subparsers.add_parser(
            "search"
        )
    )

    search_parser.add_argument(
        "--oriel",
        required=True,
    )

    search_parser.add_argument(
        "--desired-event",
        required=True,
    )

    search_parser.add_argument(
        "--mode",
        default="tour_bus",
    )

    search_parser.add_argument(
        "--candidate-locations"
    )

    search_parser.add_argument(
        "--transport-modes"
    )

    search_parser.add_argument(
        "--policy"
    )

    explain_parser = (
        subparsers.add_parser(
            "explain"
        )
    )

    explain_parser.add_argument(
        "result"
    )

    return parser


def main() -> int:
    parser = build_parser()

    args = parser.parse_args()

    try:
        if args.command == "status":
            output = status()

        elif args.command == "capabilities":
            output = capability_manifest()

        elif args.command == "selftest":
            output = focused_selftest()

        elif args.command == "search":
            policy = (
                read_object(
                    args.policy
                )
                if args.policy
                else None
            )

            output = engine.search(
                read_object(
                    args.oriel
                ),
                read_object(
                    args.desired_event
                ),
                mode=args.mode,
                candidate_locations=
                    csv_values(
                        args.candidate_locations
                    ),
                transport_modes=
                    csv_values(
                        args.transport_modes
                    ),
                policy=policy,
            )

        elif args.command == "explain":
            output = engine.explain(
                read_object(
                    args.result
                )
            )

        else:
            parser.error(
                "unknown command"
            )

            return 2

    except (
        OSError,
        ValueError,
        json.JSONDecodeError,
        oriel_error,
        oriel_inverse_error,
    ) as exc:
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "ok":
                        False,

                    "error":
                        str(
                            exc
                        ),
                },
                indent=2,
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )

        return 1

    print(
        json.dumps(
            output,
            indent=2,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            sort_keys=True,
        )
    )

    if (
        isinstance(
            output,
            dict,
        )
        and output.get(
            "ok"
        )
        is False
    ):
        return 1

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(
        main()
    )

#!/usr/bin/env python3

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Any, Dict

from providers import universal_text
from providers.base import ProviderError


PROVIDER_ID = "venice_uncensored_text"
PROFILE_ID = "venice_uncensored"

DEFAULT_MODEL = "venice-uncensored-1-2"
FEATURE_SUFFIX = "include_venice_system_prompt=true"


def available() -> bool:
    return bool(
        str(
            os.getenv(
                "VENICE_API_KEY",
                "",
            )
            or ""
        ).strip()
    )


def _model(
    request: Dict[str, Any],
) -> str:
    explicit = str(
        request.get(
            "model"
        )
        or os.getenv(
            "SAVANT_VENICE_UNCENSORED_MODEL",
            "",
        )
        or DEFAULT_MODEL
    ).strip()

    if not explicit:
        explicit = DEFAULT_MODEL

    if ":" in explicit:
        return explicit

    return (
        explicit
        + ":"
        + FEATURE_SUFFIX
    )


def infer(
    request: Dict[str, Any],
    provider: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(
        request,
        dict,
    ):
        raise ProviderError(
            "request must be an object"
        )

    if not available():
        raise ProviderError(
            "VENICE_API_KEY missing"
        )

    delegated = dict(
        request
    )

    delegated[
        "provider_profile"
    ] = PROFILE_ID

    delegated[
        "model"
    ] = _model(
        request
    )

    result = universal_text.infer(
        delegated,
        provider,
    )

    if not isinstance(
        result,
        dict,
    ):
        raise ProviderError(
            "venice provider returned non-object result"
        )

    result[
        "provider"
    ] = PROVIDER_ID

    result[
        "provider_profile"
    ] = PROFILE_ID

    result[
        "inference_latitude"
    ] = "maximum_provider_permitted"

    result[
        "provider_system_prompt"
    ] = "venice_enabled"

    result[
        "provider_content_filtering"
    ] = "provider_native"

    result[
        "owner"
    ] = "opus"

    result[
        "authority_effect"
    ] = "none"

    return result

<script>
"use strict";

const VIEWS = [
  "system",
  "architecture",
  "kindred",
  "canon",
  "ai",
  "runtime",
  "why"
];

const state = {
  data: null,
  search: [],
  current: "system",
  tour: false,
  tourTimer: null,
  graph: null
};

const $ = selector =>
  document.querySelector(selector);

const $$ = selector =>
  [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)];

const esc = value =>
  String(value ?? "")
    .replaceAll("&","&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<","&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">","&gt;")
    .replaceAll('"',"&quot;");

const fmt = value =>
  Number(value || 0)
    .toLocaleString();

function titleCase(value) {
  return String(value || "")
    .replaceAll("_"," ")
    .replaceAll("-"," ")
    .replace(
      /\b\w/g,
      letter => letter.toUpperCase()
    );
}

function metric(
  label,
  value,
  bar = 50
) {
  return `
    <div
      class="card metric"
      style="--bar:${bar}%"
    >
      <div
        class="metric-value"
        data-count="${Number(value || 0)}"
      >
        0
      </div>

      <div class="metric-label">
        ${esc(label)}
      </div>

      <div class="metric-bar"></div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function animateCounters(root = document) {
  root
    .querySelectorAll("[data-count]")
    .forEach(element => {

      const target =
        Number(element.dataset.count || 0);

      const start =
        performance.now();

      const duration =
        Math.min(
          1300,
          500 +
          Math.log10(target + 1) * 170
        );

      function frame(now) {

        const t =
          Math.min(
            1,
            (now - start) / duration
          );

        const eased =
          1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 4);

        element.textContent =
          Math.floor(
            target * eased
          ).toLocaleString();

        if (t < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    });
}

function navigate(name) {

  if (!VIEWS.includes(name)) {
    return;
  }

  state.current = name;

  $$(".view").forEach(view => {
    view.classList.toggle(
      "active",
      view.dataset.view === name
    );
  });

  $$(".nav-btn").forEach(button => {
    button.classList.toggle(
      "active",
      button.dataset.target === name
    );
  });

  const index =
    VIEWS.indexOf(name);

  $("#progress").style.width =
    `${((index + 1) / VIEWS.length) * 100}%`;

  history.replaceState(
    null,
    "",
    "#" + name
  );

  const active =
    document.querySelector(
      `.view[data-view="${name}"]`
    );

  if (active) {
    active.scrollTop = 0;
    animateCounters(active);
  }
}

function openDrawer(
  type,
  title,
  value
) {

  $("#drawerType").textContent =
    type;

  $("#drawerTitle").textContent =
    title;

  $("#drawerMeta").textContent =
    "Verified snapshot projection";

  $("#drawerBody").innerHTML =
    `<pre>${esc(
      JSON.stringify(
        value,
        null,
        2
      )
    )}</pre>`;

  $("#drawer")
    .classList.add("open");
}

function closeDrawer() {
  $("#drawer")
    .classList.remove("open");
}

function renderMetrics(data) {

  const m =
    data.metrics || {};

  const max =
    Math.max(
      ...Object.values(m)
        .filter(Number.isFinite),
      1
    );

  const bar = value =>
    Math.max(
      7,
      Math.min(
        100,
        Math.log10(
          Number(value || 0) + 1
        ) /
        Math.log10(max + 1) *
        100
      )
    );

  $("#metrics").innerHTML = [
    metric(
      "Files",
      m.files,
      bar(m.files)
    ),
    metric(
      "Relationships",
      m.constitutional_relationships,
      bar(m.constitutional_relationships)
    ),
    metric(
      "Disciplines",
      m.kindred_disciplines,
      bar(m.kindred_disciplines)
    ),
    metric(
      "Tests discovered",
      m.test_functions,
      bar(m.test_functions)
    )
  ].join("");

  $("#runtimeMetrics").innerHTML = [
    metric(
      "Files",
      m.files,
      bar(m.files)
    ),
    metric(
      "Directories",
      m.directories,
      bar(m.directories)
    ),
    metric(
      "Authority records",
      m.authority_records,
      bar(m.authority_records)
    ),
    metric(
      "Exiles",
      m.exiles,
      bar(m.exiles)
    ),
    metric(
      "Relationships",
      m.constitutional_relationships,
      bar(m.constitutional_relationships)
    ),
    metric(
      "Disciplines",
      m.kindred_disciplines,
      bar(m.kindred_disciplines)
    ),
    metric(
      "Test files",
      m.test_files,
      bar(m.test_files)
    ),
    metric(
      "Test functions",
      m.test_functions,
      bar(m.test_functions)
    )
  ].join("");

  animateCounters();
}

function renderAuthority(data) {

  const statuses =
    data.authority_statuses || {};

  const total =
    Object.values(statuses)
      .reduce(
        (a,b) => a + Number(b || 0),
        0
      );

  $("#authoritySummary").textContent =
    `${fmt(total)} traced authority records`;

  $("#authorityPills").innerHTML =
    Object.entries(statuses)
      .map(([key,value]) => `
        <span class="pill">
          ${esc(key)} · ${fmt(value)}
        </span>
      `)
      .join("");
}

  $("#edifice").innerHTML =
    (data.identity_edifice || [])
      .map((name,index) => `
        <div class="tier">

          <div class="tier-box">
            <div class="tier-name">
              ${esc(name)}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="tier-number">
            ${String(index + 1).padStart(2,"0")}
          </div>

        </div>
      `)
      .join("");
}

function createItem(
  index,
  title,
  copy,
  value,
  type,
  badge = ""
) {

  const element =
    document.createElement("article");

  element.className =
    "card item";

  element.innerHTML = `
    <div class="item-index">
      ${String(index + 1).padStart(2,"0")}
    </div>

    <h3>
      ${esc(title)}
    </h3>

    <p>
      ${esc(copy || "")}
    </p>

    ${
      badge
        ? `
          <span class="badge ${esc(badge)}">
            ${esc(badge)}
          </span>
        `
        : ""
    }
  `;

  element.addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => openDrawer(
      type,
      title,
      value
    )
  );

  return element;
}

function renderSubstrates(data) {

  const root =
    $("#substrates");

  root.innerHTML = "";

  (data.living_substrates || [])
    .forEach((item,index) => {

      const title =
        item.id ||
        item.name ||
        `Substrate ${index + 1}`;

      root.appendChild(
        createItem(
          index,
          titleCase(title),
          item.purpose || "",
          item,
          "Living Substrate"
        )
      );
    });
}

function renderDisciplines(data) {

  const root =
    $("#disciplines");

  root.innerHTML = "";

  (data.kindred_disciplines || [])
    .forEach((item,index) => {

      const title =
        item.canonical ||
        item.name ||
        item.id ||
        `Discipline ${index + 1}`;

      const relationCount =
        Array.isArray(item.relations)
          ? item.relations.length
          : 0;

      const copy =
        [
          relationCount
            ? `${relationCount} relationship forms`
            : "Relational discipline",
          item.steward || ""
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(" · ");

      root.appendChild(
        createItem(
          index,
          titleCase(title),
          copy,
          item,
          "Kindred Discipline"
        )
      );
    });
}

function renderAI(data) {

  const ai =
    data.ai || {};

  const mode =
    String(
      ai.mode || "native"
    ).toUpperCase();

  $("#aiMode").textContent =
    mode;

  $("#aiDescription").textContent =
    mode === "NATIVE"
      ? (
        "Savant is operating without external AI credentials. " +
        "Its native architecture remains valid and usable. " +
        "Configured providers can add capabilities without " +
        "changing the identity of the elements that consume them."
      )
      : (
        "External AI capability is active while Savant retains " +
        "native fallback. Provider activation augments execution " +
        "rather than becoming a new source of structural identity."
      );

  const providers =
    ai.providers || {};

  const root =
    $("#providers");

  if (!Object.keys(providers).length) {

    root.innerHTML = `
      <div class="provider">

        <div class="provider-dot"></div>

        <div class="provider-name">
          Provider registry
        </div>

        <div class="provider-state">
          native
        </div>

      </div>
    `;

    return;
  }

  root.innerHTML =
    Object.entries(providers)
      .map(([name,provider]) => `
        <div class="
          provider
          ${provider.usable ? "usable" : ""}
        ">

          <div class="provider-dot"></div>

          <div class="provider-name">
            ${esc(name)}
          </div>

          <div class="provider-state">
            ${
              provider.usable
                ? "active"
                : esc(
                    provider.reason ||
                    "inactive"
                  )
            }
          </div>

        </div>
      `)
      .join("");
}

  (data.exiles || [])

          : item.purpose || "";

      root.appendChild(

        )

}

function renderWhy(data) {

  const why =
    data.presentation?.why || [
      "To preserve meaning instead of merely storing output.",
      "To make complex systems composable instead of disposable.",
      "To keep authority, provenance and history visible.",
      "To let intelligence augment structure without owning it.",
      "To build something capable of becoming more than a collection of scripts."
    ];

  $("#whyList").innerHTML =
    why.map(line => `
      <div class="why-line">
        ${esc(line)}
      </div>
    `).join("");
}

function buildSearch(data) {

  const items = [];

  function add(
    type,
    title,
    value
  ) {

    if (!title) {
      return;
    }

    items.push({
      type,
      title: String(title),
      value
    });
  }

  (data.exiles || [])
    .forEach(item =>
      add(
        "Exile",
        item.title ||
        item.name ||
        item.id,
        item
      )
    );

  (data.authority_records || [])
    .forEach(item =>
      add(
        "Authority",
        item.title ||
        item.id ||
        item.path,
        item
      )
    );

  (data.kindred_disciplines || [])
    .forEach(item =>
      add(
        "Discipline",
        item.canonical ||
        item.name ||
        item.id,
        item
      )
    );

  (data.constitutional_relationships || [])
    .forEach(item =>
      add(
        "Relationship",
        item.name ||
        item.id ||
        item.canonical,
        item
      )
    );

  (data.living_substrates || [])
    .forEach(item =>
      add(
        "Substrate",
        item.id ||
        item.name,
        item
      )
    );

  state.search = items;
}

function showSearch() {

  $("#command")
    .classList.add("open");

  $("#commandInput").value =
    "";

  renderSearch("");

  setTimeout(
    () =>
      $("#commandInput").focus(),
    20
  );
}

function hideSearch() {
  $("#command")
    .classList.remove("open");
}

function renderSearch(query) {

  const q =
    query
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  const results =
    state.search
      .filter(item => {

        if (!q) {
          return true;
        }

        const corpus =
          `${item.title} ${item.type} ${
            JSON.stringify(item.value)
          }`
            .toLowerCase();

        return corpus.includes(q);
      })
      .slice(0,32);

  const root =
    $("#commandResults");

  root.innerHTML = "";

  results.forEach(item => {

    const row =
      document.createElement("div");

    row.className =
      "result";

    row.innerHTML = `
      <strong>
        ${esc(item.title)}
      </strong>

      <span>
        ${esc(item.type)}
      </span>
    `;

    row.addEventListener(
      "click",
      () => {
        hideSearch();

        openDrawer(
          item.type,
          item.title,
          item.value
        );
      }
    );

    root.appendChild(row);
  });
}

/* BACKGROUND FIELD */

function createSpace() {

  const canvas =
    $("#space");

  const ctx =
    canvas.getContext("2d");

  let width = 0;
  let height = 0;
  let stars = [];

  function resize() {

    const dpr =
      Math.min(
        window.devicePixelRatio || 1,
        2
      );

    width = innerWidth;
    height = innerHeight;

    canvas.width =
      width * dpr;

    canvas.height =
      height * dpr;

    canvas.style.width =
      width + "px";

    canvas.style.height =
      height + "px";

    ctx.setTransform(
      dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0
    );

    const count =
      Math.min(
        210,
        Math.max(
          70,
          Math.floor(
            width * height / 6500
          )
        )
      );

    stars =
      Array.from(
        {length: count},
        () => ({
          x: Math.random() * width,
          y: Math.random() * height,
          r: Math.random() * 1.15 + .15,
          a: Math.random() * .48 + .05,
          d: Math.random() * .15 + .02
        })
      );
  }

  let pointerX = 0;
  let pointerY = 0;

  addEventListener(
    "pointermove",
    event => {

      pointerX =
        event.clientX - width / 2;

      pointerY =
        event.clientY - height / 2;

      document.documentElement
        .style.setProperty(
          "--mx",
          `${event.clientX}px`
        );

      document.documentElement
        .style.setProperty(
          "--my",
          `${event.clientY}px`
        );
    },
    {passive: true}
  );

  function draw() {

    ctx.clearRect(
      0,0,width,height
    );

    for (const star of stars) {

      const x =
        star.x +
        pointerX * star.d * .025;

      const y =
        star.y +
        pointerY * star.d * .025;

      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.arc(
        x,
        y,
        star.r,
        0,
        Math.PI * 2
      );

      ctx.fillStyle =
        `rgba(255,255,255,${star.a})`;

      ctx.fill();
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  resize();

  addEventListener(
    "resize",
    resize
  );

  draw();
}

/* INTERACTIVE TOPOLOGY */

function createGraph(data) {

  const canvas =
    $("#graph");

  const ctx =
    canvas.getContext("2d");

  let width = 0;
  let height = 0;
  let dpr = 1;

  const source =
    (data.exiles || [])
      .slice(0,18);

  const nodes =
    source.map(
      (item,index) => ({
        item,
        index,
        angle:
          Math.PI * 2 *
          index /
          Math.max(source.length,1),
        radius:
          .33 +
          (index % 3) * .055,
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        hover: false
      })
    );

  let pointer = {
    x: -9999,
    y: -9999,
    down: false
  };

  function resize() {

    const rect =
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    width = rect.width;
    height = rect.height;

    dpr =
      Math.min(
        window.devicePixelRatio || 1,
        2
      );

    canvas.width =
      width * dpr;

    canvas.height =
      height * dpr;

    ctx.setTransform(
      dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0
    );
  }

  function target(node,time) {

    const min =
      Math.min(width,height);

    const wobble =
      Math.sin(
        time * .00022 +
        node.index * 1.7
      ) * 7;

    return {
      x:
        width / 2 +
        Math.cos(
          node.angle +
          time * .000025 *
          (node.index % 2 ? 1 : -1)
        ) *
        min *
        node.radius +
        wobble,

      y:
        height / 2 +
        Math.sin(
          node.angle +
          time * .000025 *
          (node.index % 2 ? 1 : -1)
        ) *
        min *
        node.radius *
        .78
    };
  }

  function label(node) {

    return (
      node.item.title ||
      node.item.name ||
      node.item.id ||
      `Exile ${node.index + 1}`
    );
  }

  function draw(time) {

    ctx.clearRect(
      0,0,width,height
    );

    const cx =
      width / 2;

    const cy =
      height / 2;

    const min =
      Math.min(width,height);

    /* orbital fields */

    for (
      const factor of
      [.18,.31,.43]
    ) {

      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.ellipse(
        cx,
        cy,
        min * factor,
        min * factor * .78,
        0,
        0,
        Math.PI * 2
      );

      ctx.strokeStyle =
        "rgba(255,255,255,.055)";

      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    /* center */

    ctx.save();

    ctx.translate(cx,cy);

    ctx.rotate(
      Math.PI / 4 +
      time * .000035
    );

    ctx.strokeStyle =
      "rgba(217,181,109,.78)";

    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    ctx.strokeRect(
      -44,
      -44,
      88,
      88
    );

    ctx.strokeStyle =
      "rgba(217,181,109,.25)";

    ctx.strokeRect(
      -27,
      -27,
      54,
      54
    );

    ctx.restore();

    /* update */

    nodes.forEach(node => {

      const t =
        target(node,time);

      node.vx +=
        (t.x - node.x) * .003;

      node.vy +=
        (t.y - node.y) * .003;

      node.vx *= .93;
      node.vy *= .93;

      node.x += node.vx;
      node.y += node.vy;

      if (
        !Number.isFinite(node.x) ||
        node.x === 0
      ) {
        node.x = t.x;
        node.y = t.y;
      }

      const dx =
        pointer.x - node.x;

      const dy =
        pointer.y - node.y;

      node.hover =
        Math.hypot(dx,dy) < 31;
    });

    /* graph edges */

    nodes.forEach((node,index) => {

      const next =
        nodes[
          (index + 1) %
          nodes.length
        ];

      if (!next) {
        return;
      }

      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.moveTo(
        node.x,
        node.y
      );

      ctx.lineTo(
        next.x,
        next.y
      );

      ctx.strokeStyle =
        "rgba(217,181,109,.075)";

      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.moveTo(
        cx,
        cy
      );

      ctx.lineTo(
        node.x,
        node.y
      );

      ctx.strokeStyle =
        node.hover
          ? "rgba(217,181,109,.34)"
          : "rgba(255,255,255,.045)";

      ctx.stroke();
    });

    /* nodes */

    nodes.forEach(node => {

      const active =
        node.hover;

      const r =
        active ? 25 : 21;

      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.arc(
        node.x,
        node.y,
        r,
        0,
        Math.PI * 2
      );

      ctx.fillStyle =
        active
          ? "rgba(217,181,109,.12)"
          : "rgba(7,9,13,.88)";

      ctx.fill();

      ctx.strokeStyle =
        active
          ? "rgba(217,181,109,.85)"
          : "rgba(255,255,255,.16)";

      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle =
        active
          ? "#f0d59b"
          : "#c5c7cc";

      ctx.font =
        "8px Inter, sans-serif";

      ctx.textAlign =
        "center";

      ctx.textBaseline =
        "middle";

      let text =
        label(node)
          .toUpperCase();

      if (text.length > 12) {
        text =
          text.slice(0,11) + "…";
      }

      ctx.fillText(
        text,
        node.x,
        node.y
      );
    });

    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  function point(event) {

    const rect =
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    pointer.x =
      event.clientX - rect.left;

    pointer.y =
      event.clientY - rect.top;
  }

  canvas.addEventListener(
    "pointermove",
    event => {

      point(event);

      if (pointer.down) {

        nodes.forEach(node => {

          const dx =
            node.x - pointer.x;

          const dy =
            node.y - pointer.y;

          const distance =
            Math.max(
              30,
              Math.hypot(dx,dy)
            );

          if (distance < 120) {

            node.vx +=
              dx / distance * 1.8;

            node.vy +=
              dy / distance * 1.8;
          }
        });
      }

      canvas.style.cursor =
        nodes.some(
          node => node.hover
        )
          ? "pointer"
          : "crosshair";
    }
  );

  canvas.addEventListener(
    "pointerdown",
    event => {
      pointer.down = true;
      point(event);
    }
  );

  addEventListener(
    "pointerup",
    () => {
      pointer.down = false;
    }
  );

  canvas.addEventListener(
    "click",
    event => {

      point(event);

      const node =
        nodes.find(
          item =>
            Math.hypot(
              pointer.x - item.x,
              pointer.y - item.y
            ) < 32
        );

      if (node) {

        openDrawer(
          "Exile",
          label(node),
          node.item
        );
      }
    }
  );

  resize();

  addEventListener(
    "resize",
    resize
  );

  requestAnimationFrame(draw);

  state.graph = {
    nodes
  };
}

/* CARD LIGHTING */

function enableCardLighting() {

  document.addEventListener(
    "pointermove",
    event => {

      const card =
        event.target.closest(".card");

      if (!card) {
        return;
      }

      const rect =
        card.getBoundingClientRect();

      card.style.setProperty(
        "--card-x",
        `${event.clientX - rect.left}px`
      );

      card.style.setProperty(
        "--card-y",
        `${event.clientY - rect.top}px`
      );
    },
    {passive: true}
  );
}

const TOUR = [
  {
    view: "system",
    title: "Savant as a system",
    copy:
      "The Observatory begins with the measured runtime: topology, authority and scale."
  },
  {
    view: "architecture",
    title: "Recursive composition",
    copy:
      "Identity is organized hierarchically while reusable substrates describe behavior."
  },
  {
    view: "kindred",
    title: "Kindred",
    copy:
      "Relationships are promoted into reusable, graph-addressable infrastructure."
  },
  {
    view: "canon",
    title: "Canon",
    copy:
      "Authority remains traceable through status, source, lineage and provenance."
  },
  {
    view: "ai",
    title: "AI without dependency",
    copy:
      "AI capability augments Savant. The architecture remains valid without provider credentials."
  },
  {
    view: "runtime",
    title: "Measured implementation",
    copy:
      "The numbers shown here are generated from the runtime snapshot rather than typed into the presentation."
  },
  {
    view: "why",
    title: "Why it exists",
    copy:
      "Savant is an attempt to make complex creative and computational systems retain meaning, history and extensibility."
  }
];

function stopTour() {

  state.tour = false;

  clearTimeout(
    state.tourTimer
  );

  $("#tourBtn").textContent =
    "Tour";

  $("#tourToast")
    .classList.remove("show");
}

function startTour() {

  if (state.tour) {
    stopTour();
    return;
  }

  state.tour = true;

  $("#tourBtn").textContent =
    "Stop";

  let index = 0;

  function step() {

    if (!state.tour) {
      return;
    }

    const item =
      TOUR[index];

    navigate(item.view);

    $("#tourTitle").textContent =
      item.title;

    $("#tourCopy").textContent =
      item.copy;

    $("#tourToast")
      .classList.add("show");

    index++;

    if (index >= TOUR.length) {

      state.tourTimer =
        setTimeout(
          stopTour,
          7000
        );

      return;
    }

    state.tourTimer =
      setTimeout(
        step,
        7000
      );
  }

  step();
}

/* FULLSCREEN */

async function toggleFullscreen() {

  try {

    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {

      await document.documentElement
        .requestFullscreen();

      $("#fullBtn").textContent =
        "Exit";
    } else {

      await document
        .exitFullscreen();

      $("#fullBtn").textContent =
        "Fullscreen";
    }

  } catch (_) {
    /* browser may deny fullscreen */
  }
}

/* RENDER */

function render(data) {

  state.data =
    data;

  const metrics =
    data.metrics || {};

  $("#runtimeState").textContent =
    `Verified snapshot · ${
      fmt(metrics.files)
    } files`;

  $("#snapshotHash").textContent =
    "SHA · " +
    String(
      data.snapshot_sha256 || ""
    ).slice(0,16);

  renderMetrics(data);
  renderAuthority(data);
  renderedifice(data);
  renderSubstrates(data);
  renderDisciplines(data);
  renderAuthorities(data);
  renderAI(data);
  renderExiles(data);
  renderWhy(data);
  buildSearch(data);
  createGraph(data);

  const requested =
    location.hash
      .replace("#","");

  if (VIEWS.includes(requested)) {
    navigate(requested);
  } else {
    navigate("system");
  }
}

$("#commandInput")
  .addEventListener(
    "input",
    event =>
      renderSearch(
        event.target.value
      )
  );

document.addEventListener(
  "keydown",
  event => {

    const typing =
      ["INPUT","TEXTAREA"]
        .includes(
          document.activeElement.tagName
        );

    if (
      event.key === "/" &&
      !typing
    ) {

      event.preventDefault();
      showSearch();
      return;
    }

    if (
      (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) &&
      event.key.toLowerCase() === "k"
    ) {

      event.preventDefault();
      showSearch();
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === "Escape") {

      hideSearch();
      closeDrawer();
      stopTour();

      return;
    }

    if (
      !typing &&
      event.key >= "1" &&
      event.key <= "7"
    ) {

      navigate(
        VIEWS[
          Number(event.key) - 1
        ]
      );
    }

    if (
      !typing &&
      event.key === "ArrowRight"
    ) {

      const index =
        VIEWS.indexOf(
          state.current
        );

      navigate(
        VIEWS[
          Math.min(
            VIEWS.length - 1,
            index + 1
          )
        ]
      );
    }

    if (
      !typing &&
      event.key === "ArrowLeft"
    ) {

      const index =
        VIEWS.indexOf(
          state.current
        );

      navigate(
        VIEWS[
          Math.max(
            0,
            index - 1
          )
        ]
      );
    }
  }
);

/* INIT */

async function init() {

  createSpace();
  enableCardLighting();

  try {

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "../data/savant.snapshot.json",
        {
          cache: "no-store"
        }
      );

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(
        `HTTP ${response.status}`
      );
    }

    const data =
      await response.json();

    render(data);

  } catch (error) {

    console.error(error);

    $("#error")
      .classList.add("show");
  }
}

init();

/* FOUNDER'S DEMONSTRATION CONTROLLER v3 */
(function(){
  const $d=s=>document.querySelector(s);
  const hud=$d("#demoHud");
  if(!hud) return;

  let index=0,timer=null,paused=false;
  const duration=9000;

  function data(){return (window.state&&window.state.data)||null}
  function metric(key,fallback="—"){
    const d=data(); return d&&d.metrics&&d.metrics[key]!=null ? Number(d.metrics[key]).toLocaleString() : fallback;
  }
  function p(){const d=data();return d&&d.presentation?d.presentation:{}}
  function why(i,fallback){const a=p().why||[];return a[i]||fallback}

  const slides=[
    ()=>({view:"system",k:"01 · Evidence",t:"This is not a mock statistic.",c:`The Observatory is reading a verified runtime projection: ${metric("files")} files across ${metric("directories")} directories. The interface is disposable; the runtime remains the source.`,m:[`${metric("authority_records")} authority records`,`${metric("test_functions")} test functions`]}),
    ()=>({view:"architecture",k:"02 · Architecture",t:"Complexity without duplication.",c:"Savant separates recursive identity from reusable implementation substrate. Higher structures emerge by composition, attachment, specialization and projection rather than copying lower-level substance.",m:["9 identity tiers","9 living substrates"]}),
    ()=>({view:"kindred",k:"03 · Relationships",t:"Relationship becomes infrastructure.",c:"Kindred makes dependency, lineage, provenance, evidence, compatibility, composition and other relational disciplines graph-addressable and reusable instead of scattering them through ad-hoc code.",m:[`${metric("kindred_disciplines")} disciplines`,`${metric("constitutional_relationships")} constitutional relations`]}),
    ()=>({view:"canon",k:"04 · Memory",t:"The system remembers how it became true.",c:why(1,"Savant preserves history as it evolves.")+" "+why(2,"Authority, lineage and provenance remain visible."),m:["canonical ≠ accepted ≠ provisional","supersession preserved"]}),
    ()=>({view:"ai",k:"05 · Intelligence",t:"AI is capability, not authority.",c:why(3,"Savant remains useful without an external AI provider and can become more capable when providers are available."),m:[`mode: ${(data()?.ai?.mode||"native")}`,"provider state is explicit"]}),
    ()=>({view:"runtime",k:"06 · Specialization",t:"Many owners. One composable system.",c:`The runtime currently projects ${metric("exiles")} Exiles. Each owns a bounded semantic responsibility while sharing reusable constitutional and relational machinery.`,m:["ownership remains explicit","extensions do not require replacement"]}),
    ()=>({view:"why",k:"07 · Purpose",t:"Why build Savant?",c:why(0,"To build complex intelligent software while preserving where knowledge came from.")+" "+why(4,"To make an ambitious system composable instead of brittle."),m:["lineage","provenance","replay","extensibility"]}),
    ()=>({view:"why",k:"08 · Dedication",t:p().dedication||"For Mom.",c:"This demonstration is a projection of the work itself: a system designed to grow without erasing its history, and to make the structure behind that growth visible.",m:[p().edition||"Founder's Demonstration",p().date||"August 2026"],final:true})
  ];

  function goView(v){
    if(typeof window.navigate==="function") window.navigate(v);
    else{
      document.querySelectorAll(".view").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("active",x.dataset.view===v));
      document.querySelectorAll(".nav-btn").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("active",x.dataset.target===v));
    }
  }
  function render(){
    const s=slides[index]();
    goView(s.view);
    $d("#demoKicker").textContent=s.k;
    $d("#demoTitle").textContent=s.t;
    $d("#demoTitle").classList.toggle("demo-final",!!s.final);
    $d("#demoCopy").textContent=s.c;
    $d("#demoMeta").innerHTML=s.m.map(x=>`<span>${String(x)}</span>`).join("<span>·</span>");
    $d("#demoProgress").style.width=((index+1)/slides.length*100)+"%";
    $d("#demoPrev").disabled=index===0;
    $d("#demoNext").textContent=index===slides.length-1?"Finish":"Next";
    schedule();
  }
  function schedule(){
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if(paused) return;
    timer=setTimeout(()=>{if(index<slides.length-1){index++;render()}else stop()},duration);
  }
  function start(){
    if(!data()) return;
    if(typeof window.stopTour==="function") window.stopTour();
    index=0;paused=false;
    document.body.classList.add("demo-mode");
    hud.classList.add("show");
    $d("#demoPause").textContent="Pause";
    render();
  }
  function stop(){
    clearTimeout(timer);
    hud.classList.remove("show");
    document.body.classList.remove("demo-mode");
    paused=false;
  }
  function next(){if(index<slides.length-1){index++;render()}else stop()}
  function prev(){if(index>0){index--;render()}}
  function pause(){paused=!paused;$d("#demoPause").textContent=paused?"Resume":"Pause";schedule()}

  const tour=$d("#tourBtn");
  if(tour){
    const clone=tour.cloneNode(true);
    tour.parentNode.replaceChild(clone,tour);
    clone.textContent="Demonstrate";
    clone.addEventListener("click",start);
  }
  $d("#demoNext").addEventListener("click",next);
  $d("#demoPrev").addEventListener("click",prev);
  $d("#demoPause").addEventListener("click",pause);
  $d("#demoExit").addEventListener("click",stop);
  document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
    if(!hud.classList.contains("show")) return;
    if(e.key==="Escape"){e.preventDefault();stop()}
    else if(e.key==="ArrowRight"){e.preventDefault();next()}
    else if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"){e.preventDefault();prev()}
    else if(e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();pause()}
  });
  window.startDemonstration=start;
})();
</script>
